'''Xavier Areny Fite''' (born 8 May 1957) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1976 Winter Olympics|three events]] at the [[1976 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ar/xavier-areny-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418110146/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/ar/xavier-areny-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Xavier Areny Olympic Results |access-date=17 March 2018}}</ref>
